item.text:
Yes—an agent can combine Mistral’s built-in `web_search` tool with a JSON response format.

Configure `web_search` in the agent’s `tools` and specify `response_format` inside `completion_args`, typically using `json_schema` for reliable structured output. Mistral’s cookbook demonstrates this pattern for agents with tools. [Mistral Agents & Conversations](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agents-api) · [Structured JSON agent example](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/cookbooks/mistral-connectors-01-build-a-database-advisor-agent)

One caveat: the Conversations API does not support passing `response_format` alongside `agent_id` at request time. Set it when creating the agent via `completion_args`; otherwise, enforce JSON through the agent’s instructions.
